types.description: S201M-C20 miniature circuit breaker, one pole, C characteristic, 20 A

document.title: System pro M compact — DIN Rail components for low voltage installation

modelingNotes: S1 exact selection table establishes S201M-C20. S201-family diagram verifies terminal markings 1 and 2 and an open-drawn interruptible pole. Supply direction is optional; terminal roles are bidirectional.
20 A rated current; 50/60 Hz. C-curve reference temperatures: 30 °C under IEC/EN 60898-1, 55 °C under IEC/EN 60947-2. The scalar current is a device rating, not wire ampacity.

Historical catalog: IEC/EN 60898-1 single-pole Un 230/400 V AC and Icn 10 kA; IEC/EN 60947-2 single-pole Ue 230 V AC, Icu 15 kA, Ics 11.2 kA at this current. Conditional ratings are not flattened into scalar voltage or breaking-capacity fields.

ABB Connect exact page https://www.abbconnect.nl/details/index.aspx?id=1626682 lists 6 kA at 230 V in a structured field despite its 10 kA headline and catalog evidence; discrepancy preserved in research.md.

Each numbered cylinder-lift twin terminal accepts conductor and busbar entries. Shared connection policy represents the same electrical terminal, not unlimited conductor capacity. No optional accessory terminals are included.
Open normal_state follows the manufacturer drawing, not a claim about installed handle position. No fixed continuity crosses the breaker; trip behavior and coordination are not simulated.

connectionCoverage.notes: Both numbered electrical terminals of the base one-pole breaker are represented. Twin wire/busbar entries share each numbered terminal. No neutral, PE, shield, communication or integral auxiliary connections; separately ordered accessories are outside this identity.

1.description: Main pole terminal 1; either supply direction permitted

2.description: Main pole terminal 2; either supply direction permitted
